summary.title: Creating APIs with Python - Free 19-Hour Course
summary.one_liner: A 19-hour freeCodeCamp video course that walks through building, testing, deploying and CI/CD-automating a social-media-style REST API with Python, FastAPI, Postgres and SQLAlchemy.
takeaways: Build a social-media-style API with CRUD posts, user registration, JWT login and a like/vote system using FastAPI.
Work with Postgres both via raw SQL queries and via the SQLAlchemy ORM, and manage schema changes with Alembic.
Write integration tests with pytest, including a separate test database and fixtures.
Deploy the API to an Ubuntu VM (Gunicorn, systemd, NGINX, SSL) and to Heroku, and containerize it with Docker.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for a free 19-hour freeCodeCamp.org YouTube course by Sanjeev Thiyagarajan. The course builds a full social-media-style API where users can create, read, update and delete posts, like others' posts, and register and log in. The page lists the course outline in 17 sections, covering FastAPI basics, Postgres with raw SQL and SQLAlchemy, Pydantic models, JWT authentication, relationships, Alembic migrations, pytest testing, deployment to Heroku and Ubuntu, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI/CD. The content is delivered as video; the page itself is mostly the description and syllabus.
